newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings were light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few 64.75. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
